decisive_items: Fine-needle aspiration cytology of the left breast lump revealed poorly cohesive clusters of ductal cells with pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, and prominent nucleoli; myoepithelial cells and bare nuclei were absent.
A core-needle biopsy of the left breast confirmed infiltrative duct cell carcinoma that was estrogen- and progesterone-receptor positive.
response.rationale: Cytology and biopsy results confirm infiltrative ductal carcinoma in the left breast

rejected.why: Only suspected in the right breast based on physical examination and cytology results
